title: Trusted Access Operations Lead
description:
About the team

Trusted Access helps eligible customers access and use advanced AI capabilities with appropriate safeguards. Within User Safety & Risk Operations, we connect customer onboarding, eligibility review, access provisioning, and support into a service customers can navigate with confidence.

We work with Product, Engineering, technical support, regional operations, and customer-facing teams to resolve difficult access problems and improve the systems behind them. Our work combines sound judgment on individual cases with better products, clearer guidance, and automation that reduces unnecessary friction.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior operations leader to own the Trusted Access operating strategy and lead a team of risk-operations specialists. You will set priorities across programs, build a reliable customer access service, and hire, manage, and develop your direct reports.

This role combines program ownership with formal people management. You will establish shared commitments with technical support and regional escalation leaders, who manage their own teams, and bring those groups together around customer outcomes. You’ll stay close enough to complex cases to challenge assumptions while giving specialists the ownership and capacity to fix recurring problems.

Success means customers reach the right access outcome with clear communication, teams make consistent decisions, and the service scales with less avoidable escalation and manual work.

In this role, you will:

- Own the operating strategy and roadmap across Trusted Access programs, translating customer needs and organizational priorities into clear service commitments, ownership, and investment decisions.

- Build a coherent customer journey from application and eligibility review through approval, provisioning coordination, and confirmed access, including appeals and subsequent access changes. Establish clear handoffs and route exceptions to authorized decision-makers.

- Hire, coach, and develop your team. Set expectations, delegate meaningful ownership, give direct feedback, address performance gaps, and build the capabilities needed as programs grow.

- Make capacity and prioritization decisions across urgent customer needs, launch readiness, and lasting improvements. Coordinate regional coverage, vendor support, and backup with partner teams while protecting time to eliminate recurring work.

- Lead consequential customer escalations, bringing incomplete or conflicting evidence into a clear decision process. Align owners on the next action and ensure customers receive accurate updates and a clear resolution.

- Turn support patterns into a prioritized roadmap with Product and Engineering: improve onboarding, provisioning workflows, tooling, self-service, and AI-assisted operations. Validate that changes work before expanding them.

- Establish measures of service health and decision quality. Distinguish fast responses from actual resolution, investigate persistent delays, and use evidence to change priorities.

- Prepare new programs and customer channels for launch and scale. Align support responsibilities, review standards, customer guidance, and technical dependencies; make readiness gaps and tradeoffs clear to leadership.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have built and run complex customer support, onboarding, access, risk, or service operations, with measurable improvements beyond handling more volume.

- Have formally managed people through hiring, development, difficult feedback, and performance decisions, and can show how your leadership increased the team’s capability and ownership. 5+ years of management experience preferred.

- Can make defensible tradeoffs among customer commitments, safeguards, service quality, and capacity, even when stakeholders disagree or the evidence is incomplete.

- Have led work across teams you do not manage, resolving ownership gaps and negotiating commitments that hold up in execution.

title: Product Director, Professional Services
description:
The Role
Unit4 serves a global community of professional services organizations - management consultancies, engineering and architectural practices, IT services firms, audit and advisory, and legal services. These businesses run on people: utilization, engagement profitability, and project delivery define how they win or lose. As Product Director for Professional Services, you own the vertical product vision, strategy, and roadmap that makes Unit4 the ERP of choice for mid-market PSOs.
This is not a generalist PM role with an industry overlay. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build genuine vertical depth in the platform - industry-specific capabilities that horizontal product teams cannot and will not build. You will work in close partnership with horizontal PMs across Financials, HR, Projects, and Procurement to ensure the full platform delivers for PSOs end-to-end. You own the backlog, the outcomes, the roadmap, and the commercial case for why your vertical wins.
AI is actively reshaping how professional services firms operate. The automation of billable work, the compression of traditional T&M models, and the shift toward outcome- and subscription-based pricing are rewriting the economics of the sector. The right candidate understands where these firms are in that journey and what it means for the software they need. You have built enterprise software for PSOs, you know what the best solutions in this space do well and where they fall short, and you can translate an industry in transition into a product roadmap that stays ahead of it.
What You'll Do

• Own the Professional Services product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4 's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

• Own feature outcomes, not just delivery - define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

• Serve as the internal authority on the Professional Services vertical, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

• Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

• Translate deep PSO market knowledge into specific, investment-backed product requirements: opportunity sizing, problem statements, and build-vs-partner decisions.

• Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates that accelerate customer time-to-value.

• Act as the vertical voice in planning conversations with horizontal product teams, ensuring PSO requirements are reflected in platform investment.

• Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement for new capabilities.

• Engage directly with strategic customers and the PS Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and generate outcome evidence.

• Monitor the competitive landscape - know what NetSuite, Workday, Deltek, Kantata, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4 's positioning.

• Work with partners to extend the value proposition for PSO customers.

What You'll Bring

• Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP, PSA, or enterprise SaaS - for professional services organizations. You have shipped products used by PSOs, not just advised on them.

• Deep operational knowledge of how PSOs run: pipeline-to-resource-to-revenue, utilization and leverage economics, engagement profitability, billing models, and partner/shareholder economics.

title: Sr. Software Engineer - IT Software Engineering
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Could we build a better version of an expensive SaaS tool on Elasticsearch? Our new IT Software Engineering team asks that question about the software Elastic pays for, and then we build the answer. Each system helps run the company day to day and becomes a reference architecture for Elastic's own products.

We're a team of builders, and this is a hands-on, 100% individual contributor role. Every engineer here owns their work end to end: shaping the problem, designing the system, shipping it, and keeping it healthy for years. Knowing what to build, and what not to build, matters more here than typing speed.

What this role is not: 

• Not a front-end role. The user interface follows a shared kit and is the simplest part of the work.

• Not a prototype or demo role. What we ship runs in production and is maintained for years.

• Not vibe coding. We use AI to build faster, not to skip design, review or testing.

• Not SaaS administration or configuration , and not an infrastructure-only or DevOps-only role.

• Not a people-management role.

What You Will Be Doing

• Take an open business problem, decide what to build and what to leave out, and turn it into a clear spec, data model and API contracts.

• Build internal applications that replace paid, specialized tools.

• Solve the hard parts that all of these applications share:

• reading data from several systems of record accurately and efficiently, without overloading or slowing those systems down

• storing sensitive data so it never leaks

• enforcing permissions on the server, so each person sees only the records and fields they are allowed to see

• Design and evolve the shared, versioned building blocks that every application is built from: data connectors, authorization, data storage and migrations, search, and reporting.

• Build with AI coding agents such as Claude Code inside a disciplined, spec-driven process. Acceptance criteria are traced to tests, interface contracts get compatibility checks, and small slices are reviewed and proven before the next one starts. Automated quality gates decide when work is done.

• Own what you build for its whole life: review, testing, releases, production operations including on-call, new features, maintenance and, eventually, retirement.

• Help set the team's standards for architecture, contracts, testing and observability, and feed what you learn back into Elastic's products.

What You Bring 

• Senior-level experience designing, shipping and maintaining production backend systems through failures and changing requirements, not just launching them.

• Sound judgment about what to build, what to leave out, and how to keep a system simple as its requirements change. You apply abstraction, separation of concerns, single responsibility, SOLID and common design patterns where they fit.

• Strong API and data design: clear contracts and careful data models, and the ability to change both without breaking the people who depend on them.

• Experience integrating with other systems (APIs, databases, event streams) safely and efficiently.

• Security-first thinking about authorization and sensitive data.

• Search fundamentals. You can explain:

• how information is indexed and how text is processed

• how results are scored and ranked

• when to use keyword, vector (semantic) or hybrid se

This role sits at the foundation of how we scale. Rather than stepping into a rigid playbook, you will actively participate in designing and refining our acquisition workflow from day one. title: Data Center Architect
description:
Role Profile

Job Title: Data Centre Architect

Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development

Location: UK hybrid

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one - who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.

This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.

What You’ll Do

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities

Technical negotiation with colocation providers

- Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

- Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.

- Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.

Specification & SOW

- Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.

- Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.

- Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

- Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance

- Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

- Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

- Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

- Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards

- Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

- Track the roadmap

title: Senior Operations Account Manager - Mandarin Speaking , London
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

THE OPPORTUNITY

Some of our biggest accounts are Chinese platforms, 3PLs and brokers moving millions of parcels into the UK. They grow with us when parcels arrive on time, issues get fixed fast, and someone on our side always knows exactly what’s going on. That someone is you.

As our Mandarin-speaking Senior Operations Account Manager, you’ll take on some of the most complex of these accounts and set the standard for how we run account operations as we scale. Your mission is simple to say and hard to do: make sure operations are never the reason a client hesitates to grow.

WHY THIS ROLE

A team behind every client. We’ve rebuilt our growth engine around small pods of three, built to win together. A Growth Lead owns the commercial relationship, a Program Manager triages internally to get initiatives over the line, and you own the operation that makes every promise real. Same clients, same goals, same numbers. No one carries a client alone, and every win is shared.

A real say in profitability. Margin is owned jointly by the pod through different lenses. When you cut parcel losses or make a collection run more efficiently, you’ll see exactly what it’s worth, and so will everyone else.

Scale that keeps moving. We plan to more than double daily volume by July 2027 and open one or two international markets. Your accounts, and your role, grow with that.

A career you can shape. Our Account Management team is tripling. Go deeper, taking on bigger and more complex accounts until you’re the expert the business leans on. Or go wider, across more pods, and in time lead others doing what you do.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Be the client’s go-to. Run the day-to-day relationship in Mandarin and English, on every channel, WeChat included.

- Own performance end to end. Know every metric that matters to your clients inside out, from on-time delivery to lost and undelivered parcels, and what’s driving each one. Then own every escalation from first report to final fix.

- Set the weekly rhythm. Lead weekly business reviews so clients hear the news from you first, good or bad.

- Make the forecast real. You won’t take a client’s forecast at face value. You’ll challenge it, sharpen it, and become the person whose numbers the network plans around.

- Protect the margin. Spot when an account’s profitability starts to slip, find the leak, and bring the recovery plan before anyone asks.

- Fix things once. Turn recurring issues into permanent fixes with our operations, quality and finance teams, then share them across every pod.

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE?

- You’re the person others call when a problem gets complicated, and you like it that way.

- You’ve led operational improvements that went beyond a single account, and you can show what they were worth.

- You can run a fix across operations, quality and finance at once: you map the dependencies, manage the risk and bring people with you.

title: Lab IT/OT Systems Administrator
description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Lab IT/OT Systems Administrator is a hands-on technology role responsible for the day-to-day administration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of computing infrastructure inside Lila Sciences' laboratory environments. This role owns the layer of technology that sits between corporate IT and operational technology (OT), the workstations, edge compute, lab-area networking, and instrument-adjacent systems that enable autonomous science to run reliably.

Reporting to the Senior Director, OT Security and IT/OT Convergence, the Lab IT/OT Systems Administrator works in close partnership with the OT network architecture team, corporate IT operations, facilities/building automation, and laboratory operations leadership. The successful candidate is comfortable operating in a complex, fast-moving research environment where standard corporate IT practices do not always apply, where change control matters more than speed, and where the end users are scientists running irreplaceable experiments on highly specialized equipment.

This role is a key part of Lila's IT/OT convergence program. In addition to delivering day-to-day operational support, the person hired will contribute to the standards, device catalog, and playbooks that scale the function as the company grows, working under the direction of the Senior Director, OT Security and IT/OT Convergence.

What You'll Be Building

Lab IT Operations and Support

• Provide day-to-day administration and troubleshooting for laboratory computing assets, including lab-area workstations, edge compute nodes, lab-supplied PCs, and dedicated lab-network infrastructure (switches, access points, cabling).

• Respond to and resolve Lab IT incidents and service requests through the enterprise ITSM platform, applying appropriate prioritization for experiments in progress and time-sensitive scientific work.

• Maintain a strong on-site presence across Lila's laboratory locations; observe how scientists and lab operators use technology in practice and proactively identify issues before they become tickets.

• Coordinate scheduled maintenance windows for Lab IT systems in alignment with laboratory operations leadership; ensure changes do not disrupt active experiments.

The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!
About National Taxpayers Union Foundation
National Taxpayers Union Foundation is a non-partisan research and education organization dedicated to showing Americans how taxes, government spending, and regulations affect them. Through data collection, analysis, and commentary, we empower citizens to engage in the critical policy debates of our time and hold elected officials accountable. To educate our target audiences, we perform incisive research and analysis on a wide range of policy issues with a particular focus on tax, technology, interstate commerce, legislative scoring, and trade. We also have a newly launched public interest litigation project that has extended our work into the judicial sphere.

• Taxpayers’ Budget Office: Support efforts to improve fiscal transparency, strengthen cost estimates, eliminate budget gimmicks, reduce wasteful spending, and expose costly government perks.

• Free Trade Initiative: Support initiatives that educate Americans about the economic benefits of trade.

• Center for State Competitiveness: Collaborate on efforts to resist the growing trend of states seeking to tax and regulate outside their borders, disrupting interstate commerce.

• Basic quantitative skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• An interest in public policy issues, specifically budget, tax, and regulatory matters.

• Strong research, communication, and writing skills.

Intermediate Data Scientist - Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Intermediate Data Scientist to support the development and implementation of enterprise-scale data harmonization and automation solutions within the Healthcare and Life Sciences domain.
This individual will design, develop, and optimize intelligent data processing pipelines that ingest, transform, normalize, and map large volumes of heterogeneous medical data, including structured clinical, genomic, and operational datasets, as well as unstructured information such as clinical notes and pathology reports.

• Evaluate model accuracy, processing performance, and computational efficiency across different datasets and use cases.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

• Integrate structured and unstructured data sources into standardized data processing environments.

• Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to ensure pipelines are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.

NLP & Unstructured Medical Data Extraction

• Develop and implement NLP and Named Entity Recognition (NER) models to extract relevant clinical information from unstructured medical documents.

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
 
Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant, Procure to Pay
description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

Zip is the leading procurement orchestration platform, helping companies like Block, OpenAI, Anthropic, CIBC, DollarTree, T-Mobile, and AMD manage how they buy. As a Senior Solutions Consultant on our Procure-to-Pay team, you’ll lead the implementation of Procure-to-Pay customers from kickoff to go-live, configuring Zip around their real procurement approval workflows, and shaping our product roadmap around your customer insights.

YOU WILL

- Lead end-to-end implementations across Zip’s Procure-to-Pay product, owning delivery from kickoff through go-live

- Lead discovery and design workshops with process owners and AP teams to understand their processes and pain points, and translate them into scalable, best-practice workflows

- Serve as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through configuration decisions, explaining trade-offs, and constructively challenging requests that add unnecessary complexity

- Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, driving alignment across customer stakeholders and keeping scope, decisions, timelines, and dependencies on track

- Proactively identify and resolve project risks, navigate difficult conversations, and escalate issues when needed to keep implementations moving forward.

- Partner with Technical Solutions Consultants and other internal teams to coordinate integrations and deliver a cohesive customer experience

- Lead testing and go-live readiness, helping customers validate workflows, resolve issues, and confirm the solution meets their business requirements.

- Deliver training and enablement so customers can confidently own and manage Zip after go-live

- Partner with Product and Engineering to communicate customer needs, evaluate requests, and set clear expectations with customers

- Share customer feedback, support peers, and contribute to implementation playbooks to shorten time to value and elevate the customer experience

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years as an AP or finance systems implementer, or customer-facing implementation lead in B2B SaaS

- Working knowledge of AP processes (invoice coding, three-way match, tax treatment, multi-entity and multi-currency setups) and the confidence to advise controllers and AP teams

- Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent projects and balancing competing priorities using project management methodologies

- Hands-on experience implementing or integrating with an ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle Fusion, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage Intacct, etc.), including how POs, bills, and payments flow through it, is a plus

- Comfort with configuration-heavy software work and using AI tools to speed up your own work; SQL or API skills are a plus

- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering

- The judgment to push back on client requests and guide them toward best practice while keeping the relationship strong

PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

- 📈 Start-up equity

- 🌴 Flexible PTO

- 🚠 Team building events & happy ho

Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently achieved a significant milestone of over 1 billion downloads worldwide, taking a step toward our mission of cultivating the well-being of people worldwide. With headquarters in London, UK, Gismart is a dynamic global company with a reach extending across Europe and far beyond. Our team consists of 400+ professionals who bring diversity, creativity, innovation, and relentless drive to the company. Gismart unites professionals from diverse backgrounds in entertainment, music, and tech, allowing us to play to each other’s strengths and succeed as a team.

Our mission:
Become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement.

Our values:

- Deliver what matters

- Respect and support others

- Initiate and own

- Voice openly

- Execute with quality

If you are passionate about mobile app development and want to work with a company that’s reshaping the industry, Gismart is the place for you. We offer exciting opportunities for professional growth, a supportive and collaborative environment, and the chance to contribute to products that make a tangible impact.
For more information about Gismart, visit gismart.com http://gismart.com.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Monitoring the key performance indicators affecting billing efficiency: authorization rate, risk metrics, and cost optimization (including detailed analytics)

- Working closely with the product managers, support team, finance department, management, and development team

- Doing research on the most popular payment methods in different markets

REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years of experience as a Payment Operations Manager

- Experience with chargebacks, refunds, performance metrics, cost optimization, etc

- Strong analytical mindset and systematic approach to problem-solving

- Ability to work independently and formulate hypotheses and solutions to assigned problems

- Experience with different PSPs: Stripe, PayPal, Braintree, Adyen, Checkout, and others

WOULD BE A PLUS

- Experience in the financial or banking sector

- Experience working with payment systems

- Understanding of unit economics and data-driven decision-making methodology

- Experience creating technical requirements for developers and running A/B tests

- Experience in negotiations with business partners

- Remote-First Culture: Our team is as diverse and international as our product portfolio. We offer a flexible schedule and the opportunity to collaborate remotely from anywhere in the world or from one of our corporate hubs.

- Coworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide, ensuring a comfortable and inspiring workspace.

- Free Office Lunches: Enjoy delicious, complimentary lunches when working from our corporate hubs.

- Public Holidays Policy: We provide 12 public holidays per year, accrued at a rate of one day per month.

- Sick Leave Support: We provide 100% compensation for sick leave.

- Mental and Physical Health: We partially cover medical insurance, sports activities, and therapy costs to support your well-being.

- Equipment Support: We provide the equipment needed for your projects or cover the maintenance costs of your own equipment.

- Learning and Development: We cover 70% of professional development course costs and 100% of corporate English course costs.

title: Strategy & Planning Manager
description:
Role Overview: The Strategy & Planning Manager is responsible for supporting the development and execution of the Social Care and Health Impact Framework within and across all markets.
Work Arrangement:

• Remote - This position is fully remote and requires the associate to reside in the United States (US) and maybe required to travel annually for leadership meeting.

• Reliable high‑speed internet required (minimum 50 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload)

• Associates residing in states where reimbursement is required by contract, law, or regulation may submit eligible expenses for reimbursement

Responsibilities:

• Leverage experience in population health and/or healthcare management to support strategic planning efforts and execution of critical Social Care and Health Impact strategies.

• Maintain Office of Health Impact (OHI) strategic roadmap and drive regular reviews with OHI leadership.

• Support the development of the Social Care framework as it rolls out into Markets.

• Lead and/or support OHI with strategy and roll-out projects

• Articulate, develop, and execute strategic communication materials including executive-level document development, including to the CEO.

• Monitoring business KPIs and representing status in executive level communications.

• Integrate and collaborate with OHI Social Care Model subprocesses to ensure business discipline.

• Demonstrate superior professional presence, presentation, organization, leadership, and meeting facilitation skills

• Build, maintain, and govern integrated project plans that support market teams pursuing and maintaining NCQA Community-Focused Care Accreditation.

• Coordinate cross-functional readiness activities, including milestones, dependencies, risks, evidence collection, gap remediation, and leadership reporting.

• Translate state contractual requirements related to social determinants of health (SDOH) into actionable workplans, accountable owners, deliverables, and monitoring processes.

• Partner with Market leadership teams and other stakeholders to promote consistent execution across states.

• Develop scalable tools, templates, dashboards, and governance routines that improve visibility, standardization, and timely escalation of risks.

Education & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree required

• 3 to 5 years of experience in social care, health impact strategies, project management, and developing communication materials

Skills & Abilities:

• Strong strategic planning skills with the ability to translate organizational goals into actionable roadmaps and workplans.

• Proven project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple, distinct efforts at one time and track milestones, dependencies, and risks.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop executive-level materials and present to senior leadership.

description:
Company Overview:
Empower is a fast-growing startup that is on a mission to transform the gig economy, so that hard-working drivers can earn a sustainable living. If you want to be an integral member of a team that is disrupting Uber and cares about making a difference for gig economy workers, then we’d like to hear from you.
Role Overview:
This position manages a team of 4-6 Customer Support agents and will report directly to the VP of Customer Experience.This role requires a Thursday - Monday work week and being available to timely handle issues that arise on evenings and holidays.
Additionally, this role requires candidates to be available during standard business hours for training and team meetings.
Detailed Responsibilities:

• Lead, coach, and manage a remote support team to ensure 24/7 service coverage and excellence

• Set clear performance expectations, conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and support professional development

• Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture

• Continuously refine escalation protocols, and team workflows to optimize speed and accuracy

• Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members in line with evolving support demands

• Scale quality assurance processes, including ticket audits, coaching sessions, and root cause analysis of recurring issues.

• Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the Empower platform, including both the driver and rider mobile applications

• Ensure timely correspondence with customers and consumers via phone and email

• Ensure the timely escalation of issues and trends that require broader attention

Candidate Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience in customer support or trust & safety, with 2+ years in a management or team lead role

• Exceptional judgment and decision-making skills, particularly in sensitive or ambiguous situations

• Detail-oriented, high-energy, driven, problem-solver with an exceptional work ethic and a desire to be part of a team disrupting the status quo

• Polished written and verbal communication skills

• Experience with Zendesk or similar CRM tools

• Team-first mentality and a professional attitude

• College degree

What do we offer?

• Competitive compensation: $70,000 - $90,000 base salary (based on experience) + equity + performance based bonus + competitive benefits

• Being part of a great team to better the lives of gig workers

Successful applicants will need to complete a background check.
At this time, we are not accepting submissions from external recruiters.

title: Finance Transformation Lead
description:
Overview
Position Summary:
The Finance Transformation Lead is a hands-on technology, data and process-automation leader responsible for advancing modernization across Finance. The role partners with Finance leadership to set priorities and leads the work of the Finance Innovation & Transformation Center of Excellence (FIT COE) through matrix leadership; FIT COE members remain in their functional reporting lines.
The Finance Transformation Lead complements Finance’s process expertise with technical and delivery capability. This individual works with leaders and subject-matter experts to understand current processes, identify opportunities, recommend future-state approaches, and translate business needs into practical technology solutions. The role leads selected initiatives from discovery through implementation and sustainment, and helps Finance adopt automation, analytics and artificial intelligence responsibly.

• Research relevant technologies and leading practices; recommend practical future-state processes, solution options and implementation approaches rather than relying on stakeholders to define the technical solution.

title: Bispecifics Scientist - Fully Remote | Upto $100/hr
description:
About the job
Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark , General Catalyst , Peter Thiel , Adam D'Angelo , Larry Summers , and Jack Dorsey .
Position: Preclinical R&D Expert - ADC & Bispecifics
Type: Contract
Compensation: $60-$100/hour
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10 hours/week
Role Responsibilities

• Review technical materials and real-world R&D data across ADC and/or bispecific programs .

• Label, classify, and annotate scientific data and model outputs to improve model performance .

• Provide expert perspective on key scientific and development decisions, including target/modality selection, optimization, and risk assessment.

• Help define structure and quality standards for the client's dataset pipeline.

• Participate in expert discussions, interviews, and research engagements.

Qualifications

Must-Have

• Hands-on, non-administrative preclinical R&D experience at a company that develops its own drug assets in-house and has taken programs to the clinic.

• Direct experience with ADCs and/or bispecific (or multispecific) antibodies .

• Work in a core R&D function : discovery biology, medicinal chemistry, protein/antibody engineering, computational, in vivo/translational, pharmacology/PK-PD, toxicology, or CMC/formulation.

• 5+ years of relevant industry R&D experience .

Preferred

• Experience taking a program through lead optimization or IND-enabling/preclinical development.

• Experience at mid-sized, emerging, or resource-constrained biotech, ideally outside the top-20 pharmaceutical companies.

title: Lean 4 Developer
description:
Lean 4 Developer
Pay: $60-$120/hour equivalent, paid per accepted task
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor
Time Commitment: 15+ hours per week
Schedule: Flexible
micro1 is looking for developers with practical Lean 4 experience to contribute to a project focused on improving advanced AI systems.
You will use Lean 4 and your software-development or formal-verification expertise to create challenging technical tasks, implement machine-checked reference solutions, evaluate generated code, and establish objective standards for correct solutions.
This opportunity is suited to Lean developers, formal verification engineers, proof-assistant developers, programming-languages researchers, and software engineers working with machine-checked systems. Prior professional AI-training experience is not required.
What You’ll Work On

• Create technical tasks involving Lean 4 programming, formal verification, and machine-checked reasoning.

• Develop precise specifications, definitions, theorem statements, and reference solutions.

• Build self-contained and reproducible Lean projects.

• Evaluate generated Lean code for correctness and identify type errors, dependency issues, failed tactics, or incorrect abstractions.

Public Proof of Skill
Strong applicants should provide evidence such as:

• Public Lean 4 repositories

• Mathlib or Lean ecosystem contributions

• Formal verification projects

• Lean tactics, libraries, tooling, or metaprogramming projects

• Research papers or technical reports involving proof assistants

• Open-source programming-language or verification contributions

Please provide your GitHub username and links to your strongest Lean 4 work.
Preferred Qualifications

• Contributions to mathlib, Lean, or another established Lean project.

• Experience building or maintaining substantial Lean codebases.

• Experience with Lean metaprogramming, tactic development, or formal verification.

Application Process

• Submit your application and describe your Lean 4 development experience.

• Provide links to relevant repositories, pull requests, publications, or technical projects.

• Complete an AI interview covering Lean development, debugging, and programming.

• If experience is relevant, you'll be moved to hiring-manager review.

• If selected, complete onboarding and begin your first assigned task.

Compensation

• Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid for tasks that meet project specifications and quality requirements. Task availability and completion time may vary.

title: Product Design Lead, Developer Platform
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

PRODUCT DESIGN LEAD, DEVELOPER PLATFORM

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll define the design strategy and execution for Airwallex’s end-to-end developer experience, spanning APIs, SDKs, developer tools, documentation, ecosystem integrations, and white-label customer management tools. You’ll shape how customers understand and use complex financial products and workflows, partnering with product and engineering leaders to frame problems, prioritise opportunities, and embed design early in product strategy.

- Define the design strategy for Airwallex’s developer experience across APIs, SDKs, developer tools, documentation, ecosystem integrations, and white-label customer management tools.

- Shape how customers understand and use complex financial products and workflows by framing problems, prioritising opportunities, and embedding design early in product strategy.

You'll win new advertisers and turn their first campaigns into growing, long-term partnerships with Almedia. You'll own the journey from prospecting and closing to campaign launch, optimization, and initial scale-up.

- A record of winning business. You've acquired customers, negotiated agreements, and delivered measurable revenue results in sales, business development, or a commercially focused growth

title: Sales District Manager – Financial Services (Hi-Touch Sales)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

District Sales Manager - Financial Service (金融営業部/ハイタッチセールス)

 

勤務地: 東京(千代田区永田町)

 

レポートライン: 日本RVP Sales(営業統括責任者)

 

このポジションの魅力

Everpureの日本事業において、金融業界の営業組織を率い、メガバンク、保険、証券、金融サービス企業などの戦略顧客に対するビジネス成長をリードするポジションです。金融業界では、AI活用、データマネジメント、サイバーレジリエンス、システムモダナイゼーション、ハイブリッドクラウドへの移行など、ITインフラを取り巻く重要な変革が進んでいます。本ポジションでは、単に既存案件を管理するだけではなく、顧客の中長期的なIT戦略を理解し、新しいビジネス機会を創出するとともに、Account Executive、Sales Engineer、Partner、Marketingなどをまとめ、複雑かつ大型の案件を受注につなげていただきます。また、将来の組織拡大を見据え、チームの採用・育成・パフォーマンスマネジメントにも責任を持ちます。

 

ポジション概要

Everpureでは、日本の金融業界を担当する営業チームを率いる District Sales Manager - Financial Services を募集しています。

 

本ポジションは、金融機関を担当するセールスチームをマネジメントし、専任のSales Engineer、Partner Account Manager、Inside Sales、Marketingなどの関連部門と緊密に連携しながら、担当ビジネスの成長に責任を持ちます。

 

主なミッションは以下の4点です。 

・金融業界における売上目標の達成と継続的なPipeline Creation 

・主要金融機関におけるExecutive Relationshipの構築

・拡大 ・大型かつ複雑なStrategic Dealの創出と受注 

・高い成果を継続的に生み出せる営業チームの構築・育成

 

顧客の経営課題、IT戦略、予算、意思決定構造を深く理解し、短期的な製品販売ではなく、中長期的なAccount Strategyに基づいてビジネスを拡大することが求められます。

 

主な業務内容

 

• Sales Leadership / Team Management

• FSI セールスチームをリードし、売上目標の達成・超過達成を牽引する

• AEに対して継続的なコーチングを行い、営業スキル、Account Planning、Executive Engagementのレベルを高める

• 個人およびチームのパフォーマンスを、明確な目標・KPI・期待値に基づいてマネジメントする

• 事業成長に応じた人材採用、オンボーディング、育成を行う

• Everpureのカルチャーとバリューをチームの日々の活動に定着させる

 

• Financial Services Account Strategy

• メガバンク、地方銀行、保険、証券、カード、その他金融サービス企業に対する営業戦略を策定・実行する

• 主要顧客ごとの中長期Account Planを策定し、既存ビジネスの拡大と新規ユースケースの創出を推進する

• CIO、CTO、CDO、CISO、IT部門責任者などのExecutive層との関係を構築・強化する

• 顧客のITモダナイゼーション、AI活用、データ基盤刷新、サイバーレジリエンス、クラウド戦略などの重要テーマを理解し、戦略的な提案につなげる

• 既存のITインフラ更新案件だけでなく、新しいBusiness Eventを起点としたPipeline Creationを推進する

• 競合環境を理解し、Differentiation、Displacement、Competitive Strategyをチームとともに設計する

 

• Pipeline & Forecast Management

• 年間および四半期の受注目標達成に責任を持つ

• Q+1、Q+2を含め、十分なPipeline Coverageを継続的に構築する

• 週次でForecast、Pipeline、Activity、Strategic Dealをレビューし、リスクとNext Stepを明確にする

• 大型・複雑案件について、Economic Buyer、Decision Criteria、Decision Process、Competitionなどを明確にし、受注戦略を策定する

• 重要案件にはマネージャー自身も積極的に参加し、顧客・パートナーとの交渉やExecutive Alignmentを支援する

• 長期化している案件や停滞案件について早期に課題を特定し、必要な社内リソースを投入して前進させる

• CRMおよびSales Enablementツールを活用し、Forecast AccuracyとPipeline Visibilityを高める

• 主要パートナーの経営層、営業責任者、Account TeamとのExecutive Relationshipを構築する

• パートナーと共同でAccount Planning、Pipeline Creation、Joint Sellingを推進する

• Sales Engineer、Marketing、Partner、Customer Success、Global Teamなど社内外のリソースを横断的に活用する

 

求める経験・スキル
